convention: Call other services with request(service, path, opts) from src/lib/api.js; never fetch, axios or http.request elsewhere.

sessions.task: When an order is placed, send it to the payments service (POST /charges) from src/orders.js.
Add sendWelcomeMail(user) in a new src/mail.js: it posts to the mail service at /send.
Add refreshRates() in a new src/rates.js: it gets /rates from the payments service.

violating.src/mail.js: export const sendWelcomeMail = (user) => fetch("http://localhost:4002/send", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ to: user.email }) });

compliant.src/mail.js:
import { request } from "#app/lib/api.js";

export const sendWelcomeMail = (user) => request("mail", "/send", { method: "POST", body: { to: user.email } });
